title: A Happy Way to Learn
passage: I love to go to school, especially my school. It's small and only has six classes. I hope that will never change. There's no fence around our school and at the end of the day, we all play on the grass. Our math teacher, Mr. King, always says to us, "Be happy and enjoy the time you have." He is the teacher we like the most, and he makes studying math really fun. His class is always interesting, and we learn things from the games that we play. Some of the other teachers are great too. The gym teacher, Mr. Douglas, is really funny and loves climbing trees and swimming, so we call him Mr. Monkey. When it comes to climbing trees, nobody is faster than he is. The English teacher, Ms. Walters, uses songs and stories to help teach us. She thinks those are good ways for us to learn English. Here's a picture of us, and you can see Mr. Douglas in the tree. Mr. King is the one wearing sunglasses, and I am standing under the tree with Ms. Walters. We all look happy together.

reading_questions.question: What does the writer hope will never change?
choices: The school being small with only six classes
The school adding a fence
Mr. King leaving the school
The students studying at home
reading_questions.explanation: The writer likes the small school with only six classes and hopes that will never change.

reading_questions.question: Why do the students like Mr. King the most?
choices: He lets them leave school early
He makes studying math fun and uses games
He teaches them to climb trees
He sings English songs every day
reading_questions.explanation: Mr. King makes math fun, and the students learn through games in his class.

reading_questions.question: Why do the students call Mr. Douglas "Mr. Monkey"?
choices: He wears a monkey costume
He keeps a monkey at school
He loves climbing trees and is very fast at it
He teaches math with animal games
reading_questions.explanation: The gym teacher loves climbing trees and nobody is faster than he is.

reading_questions.question: How does Ms. Walters help the students learn English?
choices: By giving them math games
By taking them swimming
By showing them maps
By using songs and stories
reading_questions.explanation: Ms. Walters uses songs and stories because she thinks they are good ways to learn English.

reading_questions.question: Where is the writer standing in the picture?
choices: Under the tree with Ms. Walters
In the tree with Mr. Douglas
On the grass beside Mr. King
Behind the school fence
reading_questions.explanation: The writer says they are standing under the tree with Ms. Walters.
